gloss: sleeping comfort; how comfortable something is to sleep on

definitions.gloss: sleeping comfort; quality of sleep comfort
definitions.explanation: The quality of comfort experienced when sleeping on a bed, futon, or other surface.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{布団|ふとん}→布団：01720_futon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{寝心地|ねごこち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: This futon is comfortable to sleep on.

examples.japanese: {寝心地|ねごこち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦マットレス→マットレス：07098_mattoresu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ベッド→ベッド：04501_beddo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{寝心地|ねごこち}⟦{最高|さいこう}→最高：02637_saikou⟧だった。
examples.english: The hotel bed was extremely comfortable.
